meta.unit: prices poller non-landing routing seam (readRound's deferred outcome handler)
meta.purpose: Task 9 wave 3 brief's mutation requirement: the seam itself (removing the advance must be killed by the principle test, alone), the reversed W2M5 (the mismatch arm keeping the starting point must now be KILLED), a per-arm landed-flag dodge for every named regression arm (the only way a future arm could evade the seam), the keep side of the invariant (a LANDED round must not advance), the liveness ping-pong (an oscillation lock must be killed), and the posture-only role of classification. Run through the wave-16 committed applier (.superpowers/sdd/wave16-mutations/mutate.py): exactly-one-occurrence asserted per edit, byte-level backups, in-memory restores verified byte-identical. Files are CRLF in the working tree, so multi-line patterns embed \r\n explicitly.
design_notes: THE DODGE SHAPE IS THE ATTACK SHAPE. With the deferred seam, 'this arm forgets to advance' is no longer expressible as a missing call -- the only way any exit keeps the starting point is to mark the round landed before returning. Every per-arm mutant below (W3M2..W3M9) is therefore a `landed = true` insertion: exactly the edit a careless future arm would need, killed to prove it cannot land unnoticed.
W3M1s repeats W3M1's edit with the test run scoped to the principle test alone, proving the class-closer kills the severed seam WITHOUT help from the named regression fleet.

W3M12 attacks the KEEP side: never setting the landed flag makes even a landed round advance. recordProgress masks that on the happy path, so the killer is the ambiguous-apply test's exploreStart assertion -- a landed round whose APPLY errs ambiguously must still have kept its starting point (the lease machinery owns that arm, d1e7d54).

W3M13 certifies classification decides POSTURE only and its unknown-wording bound stays fail-closed ERROR: classifying every failure as the recognized rejection flips transport errors to discards, killed by the tests that assert the surfaced error text. Routing is indifferent to this mutant by construction (the seam advances either way), which is exactly the round-2 restructuring.

NOT mutation-testable, disclosed: the invariant prose at the seam and in the contract (comments carry no behavior); the removal of the per-arm routeNextRoundPastDiscard calls (their absence IS the tested structure -- re-adding one alongside the seam would double-advance only in principle, and advanceExploration is idempotent for a fixed servedBy, so no test can or should distinguish it); the Step-side discard comment.

The discard/refusal halves of every arm (nothing lands, nothing recorded) remain wave-1/wave-2 mutation ground (t9w1 M2/M4/M5 at 53c0688; t9w2 W2M2 at 2981f3e); wave 3 attacks only what wave 3 changed: WHERE the advance lives and WHICH outcomes it covers.

mutations.description: the seam is severed: the deferred outcome handler no longer advances on non-landing exits
mutations.property: LANDING IS THE ONLY OUTCOME THAT KEEPS THE STARTING POINT: every post-resolution non-landing exit of readRound advances the caller-scoped exploration start through the one deferred seam

mutations.description: W3M1 again, test run scoped to the principle test alone (the class-closer)
mutations.property: the principle test kills the severed seam BY ITSELF: the invariant is pinned by the table-driven class-closer, not by incidental coverage from the named regression fleet

mutations.description: W2M5 REVERSED: the ambiguous bracketing-hash-mismatch arm dodges the seam and keeps the starting point (wave-2 behavior restored)
mutations.property: the before/after hash mismatch is AMBIGUOUS (chain movement and a stable same-token backend split are indistinguishable) and MUST advance the start: wave 2's exclusion starved the poller under a stable split while a healthy peer sat idle (round-2 finding 1)

		return none, false, nil // ambiguous discard; next cadence retries elsewhere

mutations.description: the seam's routing half becomes a no-op: routeNextRoundPastNonLanding does nothing
mutations.property: the seam's advance is real, not ceremonial: the helper the deferred handler calls actually moves the caller-scoped exploration start

mutations.description: oscillation lock: advanceExploration refuses to move an already-active exploration hint
mutations.property: LIVENESS UNDER BOTH ENDPOINTS HALF-BROKEN (round-2 question (a)): the advance must keep ping-ponging across a fully failing fleet so every endpoint is revisited and a recovered endpoint is observed within one rotation -- a hint that locks in place excludes half the fleet forever

mutations.description: the KEEP side violated: the landed flag is never set, so even a landed round advances
mutations.property: LANDING KEEPS THE STARTING POINT -- the invariant's other half: a round that landed must leave the exploration start alone even when its APPLY later errs ambiguously (the lease machinery owns that arm, d1e7d54; the seam owns only the round read)

mutations.description: classification loses its bound: every failure is classified as the recognized rejection
mutations.property: classification decides POSTURE ONLY, and its unknown-wording bound is fail-closed ERROR: a transport failure must surface as an error for the daemon's backoff, never be silently swallowed as a discard -- while routing is indifferent either way (the seam advances regardless), which is exactly round 2's separation of posture from routing
